column1: # Language batch: owner <TAB> kind <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> semantic name
# Evidence is on the declaration line itself - every constant carries its own (code, name)
# literal, so no guessing is involved:
#   a = new Language("ar","Arabic") -> ARABIC ... z = new Language("zh","Chinese") -> CHINESE
#   d("de") is labelled "Deutsch" -> GERMAN (English display name, as with all the others).
# Non-constant members are pinned by their bodies:
#   A is the Language[] used by every static lookup            -> VALUES
#   B is validated as "2-letter language code" and returned by b()/toString() -> code
#   C is the human readable label ("Arabic") returned by c()   -> displayName
#   a(String) looks the code up in VALUES                      -> fromCode
# No reflection or name-based persistence touches this class: UserConfig stores language.b()
# (the 2-letter code), so renaming cannot change saved data.
